current_patient_scope: Neuroendocrine neoplasms/ACC; title additionally names MPNST. Not evidence of an authenticated enrolled native EMC donor or any response. Full inclusion/outcome fields not used here.
prior_primary: Chioma2024 PMC11482787, already evaluated in R3; DLK1-directed ADC primary context is other cancers, not EMC.
verbatim_prior_clinical_premise_sentence: Our data support targeting DLK1 with an ADC in ACC and neuroendocrine neoplasms in an active first-in-human phase I clinical trial (NCT06041516).
This trial (NCT06041516) is currently recruiting patients with the primary objective to determine the maximum tolerated dose (MTD) of ADCT-701.
Indeed, based on our preclinical data, we have initiated a first-in-human phase 1 clinical trial with an ADC targeting DLK1 (NCT06041516).
target_identity_precision: The R3 primary directly identifies ADCT-701 as DLK1-targeting; official current record confirms actual phase I development of the same named ADC. Trial metadata alone is not a gene/protein assay.
novelty_result: Clinical-development premise genuine, but same drug/target/exact trial already known before R3 RNA shelving. Official updated recruitment state does not alter that disease-scientific decision.
